description: Source code for the LPS25HB pressure and temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, and conversion functions.

methods.name: lps25hb_power_ctrl
methods.description: Controls power state of the sensor via I2C register.

methods.name: lps25hb_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the output data rate for the sensor.

methods.name: lps25hb_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches pressure and temperature samples from the sensor.

methods.name: lps25hb_press_convert
methods.description: Converts raw pressure data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: lps25hb_temp_convert
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: lps25hb_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves specific sensor channel data (pressure or temperature).

methods.name: lps25hb_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the sensor chip, including power and configuration.

methods.name: lps25hb_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checking I2C bus readiness and calling chip init.
